name: Excess-attention continuation — chatter loud relative to dollars (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: social_excess_attention_z is the within-asset z of ln(social_volume) - ln(dollar_volume). When chatter is loud RELATIVE to money actually changing hands, real flow has NOT yet arrived, so price continues UP over ~a week as talk converts to trades. Counterparty is momentum-chasers who wait for volume confirmation. This is the strongest documented internal finding (k=7 decile spread +1.8%, t=+5.77) and is orthogonal to raw volume (coincident/beta). LunarCrush is daily next-day, so this is a SWING horizon on 1d, not intraday. DISCONFIRMER: neutralize against realized vol and dollar-volume (the external AUC-0.564-vs-0.78 warning: social is often redundant with 14d vol) — if a vol/volume control absorbs the spread, KILL. Must beat buy-and-hold net of fees at ~7d holds and survive the FDR/DSR gate on the native daily universe, not a hand-picked coin set.
catalyst: attention loud relative to realized dollar volume — flow not yet arrived
